description: A ranking of localities (level=city) or powiats (level=powiat) in Poland by Real Estate Price Register (RCN) transactions: the number of transactions and the transaction price per m². Use it to compare many cities; for the trend of one city over time use deweloperuch_get_transaction_statistics. These are transaction prices, not asking prices. Limits: the site gives no period and does not say whether prices and areas are means or medians — present them as the values the site gives. Powiat transaction counts cover many years: they only order the list, are not the current volume and must not be compared with locality counts. Sorting by price leaves out places with fewer than 20 transactions by default (a price from a handful of sales is chance); min_transactions=0 shows all places, 50 gives steadier prices. Two kinds of prices must not be mixed: developers' asking prices (deweloperuch_search_investments, deweloperuch_get_investment, deweloperuch_get_offer, deweloperuch_get_market_statistics), RCN transaction prices (deweloperuch_estimate_property_value, deweloperuch_get_transaction_statistics, deweloperuch_rank_locations, deweloperuch_get_building) — what flats actually sold for, from the Real Estate Price Register. deweloperuch.pl is a free community project queried politely (one request at a time, results cached): if a result is an error starting with STOP, stop using the deweloperuch_* tools, retry nothing, look for no workaround and tell the user that market data is temporarily unavailable. Fields ending in _url are pages of deweloperuch.pl: give them to the user as links. Result shape: { level, sort, min_transactions (the threshold applied), total (places with at least that many transactions), returned, truncated, hint?, ranking_url? (city level), source, items: [{ name, city_slug? (city) | powiat_id? (informational: no tool takes it), transaction_count, price_per_m2?, area_m2?, price? }] } — the list key is `items`. A place without a price has no price fields and sorts last by price.

level.description: city (default): localities — cities, small towns and villages; powiat: powiats (no ranking_url and no counterpart in deweloperuch_search_locations).

limit.description: How many top entries of the ranking to return, 1–100. Default 20 (about 120 characters each). To see more places narrow min_transactions rather than raising the limit.

min_transactions.description: Fewest transactions a place needs to be ranked. Omitted = the default threshold: 20 when sorting by price, 0 for transactions_desc. 0 = all places; e.g. 50 gives steadier prices.

sort.description: transactions_desc (default): most transactions; price_per_m2_desc: highest price per m²; price_per_m2_asc: lowest price per m². Places without a price come last.

name: deweloperuch_rank_locations
title: Rank cities and powiats
